Leading a project for the digitalization of the health sector in Morocco through a secure platform and mobile application, based on blockchain.
Strategic direction, organization of web training, development of photographyfsm.online website, promotion of member projects.
Technical management of projects and events of the Model United Nations club.

experiences.role: Vice President & Communication and Marketing Manager
experiences.description: Leadership and coordination of IVR club activities. Partnership management, supervision of photography section, event organization, marketing strategies and social media management.

Co-founded the Computer Science Club at Université Moulay Ismaïl (CSC-FSM) in November 2021 with Mohamed Ahram, Ayoub Elkatibi and other students from the Faculty of Sciences. The club organizes hands-on workshops, hackathons, and real projects—open to beginners and professionals alike.

Trainer for a training session on image processing within the framework of AI/Robotics and image processing training with the Moroccan Adventure Hikers Association (ARMA). Training association members and demonstrating the importance of AI and its applications across all domains.
